Responsibility

Ethics by design

Powerful AI demands profound responsibility. Our principles guide every model we train and every product we ship.

Fairness

We actively audit our models for bias and build mitigation techniques into every stage of training and deployment.

Safety

Robust red-teaming, safety classifiers, and constitutional guardrails protect against misuse and harmful outputs.

Human Oversight

AI should augment human judgment, not replace it. Our systems keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.

Transparency

We publish model cards, evaluation results, and limitations so customers can make informed choices.

Privacy

Your data is never used to train our base models without explicit consent. Enterprise data stays isolated.

Beneficence

We direct our research toward applications that broadly benefit humanity and decline harmful use cases.

Our Manifesto

We believe intelligence is a force multiplier.

We believe it must be directed with care.

We believe the future belongs to humans and machines in partnership.

We commit to building AI that is safe, fair, and accountable.

This is our responsibility. This is our promise.

Want to review our safety practices?

Download our latest transparency report or reach out to our responsible AI team.
